Category: Derivatives hedging: protect equity money (100% floor put)
What NovaFin would put money into: A 1-year put on the equity holding with a 100% floor (per ₹100 crore of equities)
Return range (% a year): Cost 4.67% of the protected amount; up to 6.75% if puts are priced dearer
How the bad year is defined: Equities −20% (Module 6's crash scenario), protected holding incl. the put's cost; unprotected −20%
Evidence strength: Medium: standard BS pricing; volatility from Module 6's real-market estimate
How fast the money can come back: Premium is spent each year; the protection lasts the year
Data gap or assumption: No market prices for index puts in the data; BS at 19.4% (checked at 25%); 1% trading cost
Controls: Buy yearly with the equity allocation; floor set by the Board's crash limit
Detail column(s): Floor, Cost a year, Stocks −20%: result
